programme.title: Rock the House
programme.desc: A busy lawyer (Jack Coleman) struggles to make time for his teen daughter (Cassi Thomson), and their relationship suffers. But when the man reconnects with his high-school bandmates, he sees positive changes in everyone. Directed by Ernie Barbarash.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: A divorced mom (Lea Thompson) and her kids are forced to bunk with a single dad (Steven Brand) and his two children after a cabin mix-up at a resort in Scotland. Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Keeping Up With the Randalls
programme.desc: A Los Angeles fashion designer (Kayla Ewell) competes in a sporting contest held by her boyfriend's family, whom she is meeting for the first time. As she flounders in several events, she begins to worry the family won't accept her. Directed by David S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Decoration Day
programme.desc: James Garner stars as a retired judge whose cantankerous attitude is tempered by a troubled godchild (Norm Skaggs), a black tenant farmer (Bill Cobbs) who refuses the Medal of Honor and a blossoming romance. Judith Ivey. Rowena: Ruby Dee. Michael Waring: Larry Fishburne. Loreen: Jo Anderson. Judge Wesley: Wallace Wilkinson. Adapted from the novella by John William Corrington.

programme.title: Working Miracles
programme.desc: Following a brush with death, a janitor (Eddie Cibrian) discovers that he can heal others with just his touch. He relishes his new ability until he realizes that it's taking a toll on his own health, forcing him to make an important decision. Lisa Sheridan, Patrick Duffy, Meagen Fay. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: Where There's a Will
programme.desc: A debt-ridden con man returns home to care for his wealthy grandmother hoping to become her sole heir.

programme.title: Cloudy With a Chance of Love
programme.desc: A meteorology graduate student gets the opportunity to do the weather on a local TV-news show, where there's the potential for a full-time job and a possible romance with a co-worker.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's surprise pregnancy sets her on a new course that is both thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie, have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Now, caught between the excitement of the new adventure and the pain of not knowing when she'll see her family again, Missie copes with the challenges, and cherishes the rewards, of her new homestead.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: A troubled young mother pins her hopes on winning an equestrian event after her husband leaves her to raise their daughter alone.

programme.title: Romantically Speaking
programme.desc: A relationship expert's public love life goes on the rocks, so her best male friend steps in to help keep up appearances, and their relationship takes an interesting turn.

programme.title: You've Got a Friend
programme.desc: Dylan McLaughlin plays Bobby, a boy who recently lost his parents and finds solace in box-car racing with help from the town loner (John Schneider), a former derby racer himself. But victory doesn't come easy for Bobby as he is forced to confront a bully and disapproval from his uncle (Jason Brooks). Miss Nelson: Bitty Schram.

programme.title: Love Comes Softly
programme.desc: Marty is a 19 year old pioneer woman, recently married. She goes west with her husband Clem, hoping to start a new life. But Clem unexpectedly dies, and Marty finds herself alone, two months pregnant. Clark Davis, a widower, offers her a marriage of convenience: she needs food and money, and he needs someone to take care of his daughter Missie. She accepts his proposal as a temporary solution.

programme.title: Always a Bride
programme.desc: A woman lets loose during her bachelorette party in Las Vegas and wakes up married to a movie star, much to her fiancé's chagrin. Delays with an annulment further complicate matters, and the woman is left questioning which man is truly right for her.

programme.title: Mulligan
programme.desc: A kids-show actor (Ethan Erickson) and a single mom (Jennie Garth) butt heads after the two are in a car accident. But while dealing with the fallout from the crash, the pair begin to make a real connection. The actor's secrets, however, threaten to ruin the fledgling romance. David Burton Morris directed.

programme.title: Change of Heart
programme.desc: A TV producer decides to set a show at a bed and breakfast and bonds with the owner's son. But he becomes furious after learning one of her secrets.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: In this romantic tearjerker, an angst-ridden doctor (Lisa Hartman Black) returns home to attend a high-school reunion---and to mend fences with loved ones she left behind. Helen: Rue McClanahan. Gus: Dale Midkiff. Nelson: Larry Manetti.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Legally Tender
programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.title: Home Fires Burning
programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: Vickery's Wild Ride
programme.desc: A successful ad man (Jonathan Silverman) tries to reconnect with his family by taking them on a monthlong vacation to a rustic cabin that he recently inherited. Though resistant at first, the family start to enjoy themselves after meeting a cowboy (Peter Strauss) who teaches them about life's simpler pleasures.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: The sixth installment of the "Love Comes Softly" series follows the now-grown Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) as she struggles to choose between her career aspirations as a doctor and her feelings for a New York lawyer who wants a traditional wife. Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Friend Request
programme.desc: A woman seeking romance finds an ideal man online, but she gets a surprise when she meets him and learns that his young son was posing as his dad and communicating with her.

programme.title: Mystery Girl
programme.desc: A man (Sean Patrick Flanery) sends secret-admirer e-mails to his crush (Christine Scott Bennett), but an e-mail-address mix-up causes the notes to go to the woman's lovelorn coworker (Brigid Brannagh) instead. And though the man and his crush start dating, he can't help but feel a connection with the woman he'd been e-mailing. Directed by Allison Anders.

programme.title: The Michaels
programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Hearts on Fire
programme.desc: Romance blooms between a single mom and an injured firefighter who is renting a room in her home while he recovers. Though her kids are instantly taken with him, the woman has doubts about the wisdom of starting a new relationship.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: To save his family bakery, a Bronx baker (Costas Mandylor) with a flair for pastries partners with a talented Manhattan pastry chef (Lauren Holly) to enter a dessert competition with a $250,000 grand prize. Uncle Fabrizio: David Proval. Jim: Bruce Thomas. Jacques Du Jacques: Andy Lauer.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do?
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.desc: A single mom and a widowed dad tie for the presidency of the PTA at their children's elementary school, where they engage in a power struggle and eventually realize they have feelings for each other.

Troop: Robert Urich. Dan: Kaj-Erik Eriksen. Wade: Robert Wisden. Mrs. Troop: Sandra Nelson. Michael Anderson directed.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. She finds a new home, and finds a new teaching position that she settles right into, but Missie has lost all faith in herself, until a chance encounter at her father's church where she adopts homeless orphan Belinda Marshall.

programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: A huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) and a fellow warrior (Jessica Chastain) battle an ice queen (Emily Blunt) and her evil, resurrected sister (Charlize Theron).

programme.title: Four Christmases
programme.desc: When their plans for a holiday getaway fall apart, a couple (Vince Vaughn, Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging to a quartet of family get-togethers.

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: A cynical nightclub owner (Humphrey Bogart) protects an old flame (Ingrid Bergman) and her husband (Paul Henreid) from Nazis in Morocco.

programme.title: Frost/Nixon
programme.desc: An on-air battle of wits ensues when former President Richard Nixon selects British TV personality David Frost for an exclusive post-Watergate interview.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: A shy teenager dreams of escaping her small town and pursuing her passion to sing. With the help of an unlikely mentor, she enters a local singing competition that will test her integrity, talent and ambition.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: After her release from prison, a former CEO (Melissa McCarthy) battles old enemies while trying to build a brownie empire with her ex-assistant (Kristen Bell).

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous: The Movie
programme.desc: London publicist Edina Monsoon and best friend Patsy Stone flee to the French Riviera after accidentally knocking supermodel Kate Moss into the River Thames.

programme.title: Notting Hill
programme.desc: A man's (Hugh Grant) life changes when an international star (Julia Roberts) walks into his bookshop.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: A family man finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. However, when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, he's forced to navigate the consequences of his newfound stardom.

programme.title: Trap
programme.desc: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert.

programme.title: Addicted
programme.desc: A successful businesswoman (Sharon Leal) puts her family, career and life on the line to satisfy her addiction to sex.

programme.title: Edge of Darkness
programme.desc: After his daughter is shot on his doorstep, a Boston detective (Mel Gibson) learns about her secret life and a far-reaching coverup linked to her death.

programme.title: Working Girls
programme.desc: A photographer (Louise Smith) and others work for a yuppie madam (Ellen McElduff) in a Manhattan brothel, then go home.

programme.title: Fantastic Planet
programme.desc: The 39-foot-tall pastel Draags keep leashes on the Oms, their tiny pets descended from humans.

programme.title: Godzilla Raids Again
programme.desc: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan.

programme.title: Nine Lives
programme.desc: A workaholic billionaire (Kevin Spacey) tries to communicate with his family when a bizarre turn of events traps him inside the body of a cat named Mr. Fuzzypants.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager (Israel Broussard) and his gang of fame-obsessed youths (Katie Chang, Taissa Farmiga) use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: Water for Elephants
programme.desc: A shared compassion for a special elephant draws together a former veterinary student (Robert Pattinson) and a performer (Reese Witherspoon) in the traveling circus in which they both work.

programme.title: The Martian
programme.desc: Left behind by his crew, a stranded astronaut must find a way to survive on Mars, while NASA and a team of international scientists work tirelessly to bring him home.

programme.title: Taking Woodstock
programme.desc: Elliot Tiber plays a pivotal role in the generation-defining concert by helping to secure Max Yasgur's farm as a venue and offering his parents' motel as a base for organizers.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: The assassination of JFK is seen through the eyes of Jackie Kennedy. The days leading up to the tragedy and the immediate aftermath are chronicled, as experienced by the First Lady, wife of the charismatic president and mother of two small children.

programme.title: Dim Sum Funeral
programme.desc: The grown children of an overbearing Chinese matriarch reluctantly gather to take part in seven days' worth of traditional funeral rites.

programme.title: Your Monster
programme.desc: A soft-spoken actress finds her voice again when she meets a terrifying but weirdly charming monster that lives in her closet.

programme.title: Wilson
programme.desc: After reuniting with his ex-wife (Laura Dern), a lonely and neurotic misanthrope (Woody Harrelson) tries to form a connection with the teenage daughter (Isabella Amara) he never knew he had.

programme.title: Tuesday
programme.desc: A mother and her daughter must confront Death when it arrives in the form of an astonishing talking bird.

programme.title: The Iron Claw
programme.desc: The true story of the Von Erich brothers, who, through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, seek epic immortality on the biggest stage in sports.

programme.title: Walkabout
programme.desc: A lost teenager (Jenny Agutter) and her little brother (Lucien John) meet an Aboriginal teen (David Gulpilil) in the Outback.

programme.title: Casablanca
